description: This file serves as the entry point for a React web application. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS file, and the main App component. It initializes the React application by rendering the App component into the DOM element with the ID 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React application into a DOM node.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the created root.
